facts.value: As part of your study program in our Department of Economics, you can complete certain modules in other departments, so-called import modules from other departments - including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.

For the courses in the Department of Economics, an overview is provided of which import modules you can register for in other departments and how you can incorporate these import modules into your study program in the Department of Economics. Furthermore, you cannot incorporate any other modules from other departments into your study program in the Department of Economics and you cannot earn deviating Credit Points (CP).
